title: Too many windows? Switch in 1 second ⚡ #Shorts
description:
Lost in a pile of open windows? Hold Alt and tap Tab to jump straight back to your last window.

⌨️ Windows: Alt + Tab
🍎 Mac: Cmd + Tab

Keep holding Alt (Cmd on Mac) and tap Tab again to cycle through all open apps.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
